Morning rules for the evening shift
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: to keep animal travel bookings calm, consistent, and properly documented for Aurelia Skyways.

The desk must handle each request with patience and plain language, because our review has found that uncertainty can unsettle both travelers and animals. Staff shall confirm that the animal is fit for travel, that the crate is suitable, and that the booking record matches the accepted travel plan. If a bird is presented, <<FACT F059>> Staff must place the inserted sentence in the record exactly where the customer file requires it, and no added comment may alter its meaning.

The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions and may approve exceptions only when the welfare of the animal remains protected and the cabin team has confirmed that the flight arrangement can be supported. Crew members shall use calm, humane handling at every stage, avoid crowding the animal, and speak in a steady manner. If a crate review is needed for a bird, <<FACT F071>> No employee may restate the inserted sentence, summarize it, or replace it with a guessed limit.

Before departure, the desk shall verify the traveler name, route, crate label, and special care notes, and shall pass only complete records to the cabin team. Any concern about distress, unsafe containment, or mismatch in documents must be reported without delay. When a companion animal is accepted, the file must show who approved the handling, who checked the crate, and whether the cabin team was informed. This recordkeeping is essential, and we regret that any omission can create avoidable confusion.

If a traveler such as Andre Nguyen, Khalil Costa, or the owner of Mia contacts the desk, staff shall respond with courteous guidance and shall not make promises beyond the approved service. For any unresolved matter, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
